title: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
question: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T1.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom_molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '+'
